question: Ginny starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the North. She takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 3 km and 4 km, respectively. She then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. She takes a final left turn and drives 3 km to reach point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Ginny starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the North.

She takes two simultaneous left turns and drives 3 km and 4 km, respectively.

She then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. She takes a final left turn and drives 3 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a9ed3c4140d4e1b4552e47642b70adad1cf7f302edb260107267b2625a5ac45.png] 

Thus, Ginny has to drive 5 km towards east to reach point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1".**
